More product per dollar, bonded to fabric for longer, and backed by the most trusted name in permethrin treatment. --- ## How Permethrin Works (And Why You Need It) Permethrin is fundamentally different from DEET or picaridin. While those are *repellents* that go on your skin, permethrin is an *insecticide* that you apply to clothing and gear. It bonds to fabric fibers and kills ticks, mosquitoes, chiggers, and mites on contact. The key stats: - **97% tick mortality rate** in controlled studies - **100% mosquito knockdown** for treated clothing - **Lasts 6 weeks or 6 washes** — not just overnight - **Odorless and invisible** when dry - **Safe for fabrics** — won't stain or damage synthetics, cottons, or wool --- ## Sawyer Permethrin — The Category Leader The [**Sawyer Premium Permethrin**](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B001ANQVYU?tag=worthitgoods-20) is the most recommended permethrin product in the outdoor industry.
